mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO journal_line ( id, journal_entry_id, ledger_account_id, side, amount ) VALUES
( #{line.id, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{journalEntryId, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{line.ledgerAccountId, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{line.side}, #{line.amount} )
mapper.select: SELECT je.id AS journal_id, jl.id AS line_id, jl.side, jl.amount, je.posted_at FROM journal_line jl JOIN journal_entry je ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id WHERE jl.ledger_account_id = #{ accountId, typeHandler=com.globalpay.lab.ledger.infrastructure.UUIDTypeHandler } AND je.status = 'POSTED' ORDER BY je.posted_at DESC, je.id DESC, jl.id DESC
